Format

[edit]

Group Stage

[edit]
  • Dual Tournament Format:
    • All matches are Bo3.
    • Top 2 players of each group advance to the Playoffs.

Playoffs

[edit]
  • Double-elimination bracket:
    • Upper Bracket Quarterfinals and Semifinals are Bo5, Upper Bracket Final are Bo7.
    • Lower Bracket are Bo5 except Lower Bracket Final which is Bo7.
    • Grand Finals are Bo7.
      • Grand Finals are played offline at BlizzCon 2026.
